messages:
Nina R.: User reporting onboarding friction: Python quickstart crash on Windows. README uses `source venv/bin/activate` which fails.
Jae L.: Yeah that's POSIX-only. We should show PowerShell and cmd variants. Example to add to README:
```
python -m venv venv
# mac / linux
source venv/bin/activate
# windows (powershell)
.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# windows (cmd)
venv\Scripts\activate.bat
```
Priya S.: Also found an env var mismatch in the sample: README exports `REDWOOD_KEY` but SDK reads `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Users get a non-obvious `AuthenticationError: missing api key`.
Nina R.: Oof. Suggest adding a preflight guard in the sample so it fails fast with a helpful hint. Small snippet: `if not os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("REDWOOD_API_KEY not set; export it or use .env")`.
Jae L.: Doc copy also still says "automatic retries on 5xx". We tightened defaults to avoid re-sending bodies; generate endpoints aren't retried by default. Need to update quickstart to clarify and show opt-in for body retries.
Priya S.: Opt-in example to paste in docs:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], retry_policy={'retries':3,'retry_on':[502,503,504],'allow_body_retries':True})
```
Nina R.: Minor devex/typing note: our `redwood/__init__.pyi` stub returns `Any` for Client constructor which worsens editor completions. Filing a separate typing issue.
ci-bot: Created issue #3187 linking sample fixes, docs clarification, and pyi typing bug.
Jae L.: Samples currently pin `redwood-inference==0.12.0` but CI released 0.13.0 with a breaking arg. Recommend changing to `>=0.12.0,<0.15.0` and adding a short compatibility note.
Priya S.: I'll open a small PR against `samples/python/quickstart` with: Windows activation variants, env var preflight, retry clarification, and loosened pip spec. Will also link the typing issue so reviewers see it.
Nina R.: Thanks — once PR merges, let's add a troubleshooting bullet in docs for "Windows venv activation" and link to sample README to reduce duplicate tickets.
Priya S.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/451 — small changes, ready for review. :shipit:
